thread:
mira: Quick notes from design sync — focus: roles 'lane' (vertical compact rows) + SSO hint copy + audit log nav. Wanted to capture what we agreed and open a few Qs.

sam: Thanks. Main pain: keyboard users lose context when lanes collapse. Focus ring jumps to the wrong row sometimes.

eva: Repro steps I saw: tab into roles grid -> hit collapse toggle -> focus goes to top of grid. We should preserve focus to the row header. :eyes: 

mira: Agreed. Proposal: when collapsing, set focus to the collapsed row's toggle button with `aria-expanded` update. Sample:

```html
<button aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="lane-7" id="lane-toggle-7">More</button>
``` 

sam: That helps. Also screenreader text — add `aria-live="polite"` for the collapse message so SR user hears context change.

alex: UX copy: current SSO toggle label 'Require SSO for org' is long. Suggest 'Enforce SSO' with microcopy tooltip 'Members sign in via company SSO'. Thoughts?

eva: 'Enforce SSO' shorter but could read as punitive. Maybe 'SSO required' + help text 'Members must use company SSO to sign in'.

mira: OK we'll A/B the two in the mock. Also audit log nav — folks requested breadcrumb to jump to filtered views (e.g., 'Invite events', 'Role changes').

sam: Could we add quick filters chips at top: [Invites] [Role changes] [SSO events] — keyboard-accessible, focusable buttons.

design-bot: automated a11y scan: 3 contrast issues in tooltip copy, 1 missing focus-visible style in grid rows.

mira: I'll update the prototype and tack on notes for devs: preserve focus, add `aria-live`, quick filter chips, and copy variants. @sam @alex — can you review the updated figma by EOD? :thumbsup: 

sam: On it.

alex: ✅ will review, will also sync with legal about SSO wording.

eva: I'll run a keyboard pass after the figma update, calling out any remaining focus traps. :accessibility: 

mira: Thanks team — capturing these in the ticket now: https://rwd.internal/ticket/INF-4321
